cases.title: Add single note via button click
cases.description: Verify that clicking the "Add note" button (data-testid="add-note-button") creates a new note <div> with class="note" appended to the document body, containing a visible, empty <textarea> (data-testid="note-textarea").

cases.title: Add multiple notes via rapid clicks
cases.description: Verify that multiple rapid clicks on the "Add note" button successfully create multiple separate note elements, each containing its own unique textarea.

cases.title: Real-time Markdown Rendering and Editing
cases.description: Verify that typing Markdown content (such as headings, bold, italic, and links) in the note textarea dynamically and correctly renders HTML in the main display area (data-testid="note-main") in real-time, and that changes are instantly persisted to local storage.

cases.title: Handling Invalid Markdown Syntax
cases.description: Verify that entering invalid Markdown syntax (e.g., unmatched asterisks) does not crash or throw errors in the application, and that exiting the edit mode by clicking the "Edit" button appropriately handles the raw input without application failure.

cases.title: Create note and verify initial edit mode state
cases.description: Verify that when the app page loads and the user clicks the "Add note" button (data-testid="add-note-button"), a new note is created and immediately enters edit mode where the textarea (data-testid="note-textarea") is visible and the main content area (data-testid="note-main") remains hidden.

cases.title: Toggle between edit and view modes
cases.description: Verify that users can switch between edit and view modes by clicking the "Edit" button (data-testid="edit-note-button"). In view mode, the main content area becomes visible and the textarea is hidden, and in edit mode, this behavior is reversed.

cases.title: Automatic saving to local storage across sessions
cases.description: Verify that all changes typed into the textarea are automatically saved to local storage, preserving the note’s state across sessions.

cases.title: Delete note removes it from DOM and localStorage
cases.description: Verify that clicking the delete button (data-testid="delete-note-button") for a specific note immediately removes the note element from the DOM and deletes the corresponding entry from localStorage.

cases.title: Delete specific note among multiple notes
cases.description: Verify that when multiple notes are present, clicking the delete button on a specific note removes only that note from the DOM and localStorage while leaving other notes intact.

cases.title: Restore notes from localStorage on page load
cases.description: Verify that when the webpage loads with stored notes in localStorage, the application retrieves them using JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('notes')) and dynamically creates a div with class 'note' for each, containing the edit button, delete button, main div (data-testid='note-main'), and textarea (data-testid='note-textarea'). For populated notes, the main div is visible and the textarea is hidden.

cases.title: Handle empty content notes on page load
cases.description: Verify that notes retrieved from localStorage that have no content are rendered with the textarea visible and the main content div hidden by default to allow immediate editing.

cases.title: Handle empty localStorage on page load
cases.description: Verify that when the application loads and localStorage is empty or has no notes, no note elements are displayed on the page.

opinions.feedback: The proposed high-level test cases are well-structured, distinct, cover all requirements effectively, and are fully testable without any blockers.

analysis.analysis: R-1: Testable behavior includes clicking the "Add note" button (id="add", class="add", data-testid="add-note-button") and verifying a new <div> with class="note" and an empty <textarea> (data-testid="note-textarea") is appended to the body. Boundaries: Multiple rapid clicks creating multiple distinct notes. Normal path: Single click creates one note. Abnormal path: Rapid successive clicks. Ambiguities: None. R-2: Testable behavior includes typing Markdown in the textarea, dynamic real-time rendering in data-testid="note-main", and clicking the "Edit" button (data-testid="edit-note-button") to exit edit mode. Normal path: Standard Markdown elements (#, **, _, [link]). Abnormal path: Invalid Markdown like unmatched asterisks (should not crash, falls back to raw input on exit). Persistence: LocalStorage updates immediately. Ambiguities: Exact behavior of invalid Markdown during live typing vs. exit mode. R-3: Testable behavior includes application load, creating notes, immediate entry into edit mode (textarea visible, data-testid="note-main" hidden), and toggling between view and edit modes via the "Edit" button. Normal path: Click add note -> edit mode -> type -> click edit -> view mode. Abnormal path: Toggling repeatedly. Ambiguities: None. R-4: Testable behavior includes clicking data-testid="delete-note-button" to remove the note from the DOM and localStorage. Normal path: Deleting an existing note. Abnormal path: Deleting already removed or non-existent notes. Ambiguities: None. R-5: Testable behavior includes page load retrieval from localStorage via JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('notes')), DOM construction with class="note", tools div, edit/delete buttons, main div (data-testid="note-main"), and textarea (data-testid="note-textarea"). Normal path: Populated localStorage restores notes with main div visible and textarea hidden. Abnormal path: Empty localStorage (no notes shown) or notes with no content (textarea visible, main div hidden). Ambiguities: Structure of the stored array elements.
